## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to the current requirement.
- [ ] The logic is easy to follow and avoids unnecessary abstraction.
- [ ] Components/functions are split where it improves readability.
- [ ] Names are clear and domain-oriented.
- [ ] Comments explain non-obvious decisions, not obvious code.
- [ ] Error paths and edge cases were considered.
- [ ] No debug logs, breakpoints, TODO placeholders, or temporary code were left behind.
- [ ] UI changes were checked on relevant viewport sizes.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks locally.
